root_directory.description: The root directory where the registry stores its blob data.

http_addr.description: The network address and port the registry HTTP server listens on.

auth_htpasswd_realm.description: The realm name presented to the client during htpasswd authentication.

auth_htpasswd_path.description: The filesystem path to the htpasswd file used for authentication.

health_storagedriver_enabled.description: Whether to enable health checks for the storage driver.

health_storagedriver_interval.description: The interval duration between health checks for the storage driver.

health_storagedriver_threshold.description: The number of consecutive failures before marking the storage driver as unhealthy.
